I'd stay away from it. DMAA is a stimulant that regulators in the US and many other countries have banned in supplements, and it has been tied to serious cardiovascular problems. Products that still list it are sold outside the rules, so you can't count on the label being accurate either.

For a doctor or dietitian, the question is what stimulant, if any, makes sense for you, and they can give you an amount. On the training side, sleep, a proper meal an hour or two beforehand, and a solid warm-up do more for most people than any preworkout. Want me to look at how your sessions have been feeling lately?
